glossary.definition_or: ଯାହା ସବୁ ସ୍ଥାନ ଅଣାଅଛି ଓ ଭାର ଅଛି।
glossary.definition_en: Anything that has mass and occupies space.

glossary.definition_or: ପଦାର୍ଥର ସ୍ଥିତି — ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଆକାର ଓ ଆୟତନ।
glossary.definition_en: State of matter with fixed shape and volume.

glossary.definition_or: ପଦାର୍ଥର ସ୍ଥିତି — ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଆୟତନ କିନ୍ତୁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଆକାର ନୁହେଁ।
glossary.definition_en: State of matter with fixed volume but no fixed shape.

glossary.definition_or: ପଦାର୍ଥର ସ୍ଥିତି — ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଆକାର ବା ଆୟତନ ନୁହେଁ।
glossary.definition_en: State of matter with no fixed shape or volume.
Mass per unit volume.

glossary.definition_or: ପଦାର୍ଥ ଘନତ୍ୱ ଓ ଜଳ ଘନତ୍ୱର ଅନୁପାତ।
glossary.definition_en: Ratio of density of substance to density of water.
Change of state from solid to liquid.
Change of state from liquid to gas.
Temperature at which a solid melts.
Temperature at which a liquid boils.
Change of state from gas to liquid.
Change of state from liquid to solid.
Direct change from solid to gas.
Change of position with time.

glossary.definition_or: ଆରମ୍ଭ ଓ ଶେଷ ସ୍ଥାନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସିଧା ଦୂରତା।
glossary.definition_en: Shortest distance between initial and final position.
Distance covered per unit time.
Displacement per unit time (vector).
Rate of change of velocity.
Group of cells with similar function.
Actively dividing plant cells.
Simple permanent plant tissue with thin walls.
Plant tissue with pectin thickening.
Plant tissue with lignin thickening.
Conducts water and minerals in plants.
Conducts food in plants.
Covers body surfaces and lines cavities.
Supports and connects body parts.
Contractile tissue causing movement.
Transmits signals.
Nerve cell with body, dendrite, axon.
